name: Gap-Guided Iterative Retrieval
mechanism: Alternates bounded reasoning with retrieval queries derived from explicit missing-evidence gaps until sufficient evidence or a hard stop is reached.
use_when: Multi-hop evidence dependencies cannot be expressed fully before the first retrieval
Offline replay shows later queries recover required missing hops
avoid_when: Evidence-sufficiency judgments are uncalibrated or no hard iteration budget exists
expected_effects: Explicit trace of gaps queries evidence and stop reasons
failure_modes: Self-confirming queries reinforce an early false premise
False sufficiency stops before required evidence
Repeated queries inflate latency and cost without new evidence
required_evals: latency token cost and tool calls
